sourceVisualNotes: Six actual inventory icons viewed: white lily spray; tall gold-edged dark shield; red octagonal STOP paddle; compact yellow energy ball; thumbs-up hand; pink watering can. The bright source halos are excluded from the inventory silhouettes; 4503 is represented as a self-contained translucent energy orb, not a background glow or an adopted combat effect.

items.name: ivory-lily-spray
items.designBrief: One compact spray of THREE ivory lilies with soft pale-cyan shaded petals, small gold stamens, jade leaves and a short bundled green stem. Delicate warmgold ties, complete petals and stem, no wrapping paper or background halo.

items.name: gold-jade-guardian-shield
items.designBrief: One tall narrow rounded-diamond guardian shield, dark jade enamel center, thick warmgold beveled rim, raised original small gourd-and-cloud emblem. Tapered lower point, symmetric protective side ridges. No face or text, distinguish from previous blue pointed shield.

items.name: red-stop-paddle
items.designBrief: One RED OCTAGONAL handheld sign on a short complete dark wood handle. Fine ivory/gold border, exact centered readable uppercase STOP in ivory, no other lettering. Straight frontal plaque, all eight corners and handle visible, no shadow behind.

items.name: golden-qi-orb
items.designBrief: One self-contained round golden translucent qi orb, bright small ivory core inside a visible spherical amber boundary, three internal curling cloud ribbons with restrained jade accents. ALL luminous strokes stay INSIDE the orb; outside truly transparent, no ambient bloom, rays, starbursts or background halo. Single inventory token, not animation.

items.name: jade-cuff-thumbs-up
items.designBrief: One friendly chibi hand giving a clear THUMBS UP: exactly one raised thumb and four folded fingers, warm skin, short ivory sleeve cuff with jade/gold trim at wrist. Whole hand and cuff, no arm/person, no lettering or badges, correct thumb anatomy.

items.name: pink-lotus-watering-can
items.designBrief: One plump PINK watering can, rounded oval body, curved handle on right, long spout on left ending in a flared rose sprinkler head, lid at top. Ivory lotus medallion with jade leaves, fine gold rims, one small contained water droplet under spout. Whole handle/spout inside cell, no ground or decorative background.
